scientific_integrity: The finite proof is given by reproducible exact signed integer chain matrices and exact Smith diagonalization; no infinite-parameter or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the ternary 13-point projective plane; determines integral homology and quadrangle-cycle index, not homotopy type or complete automorphism-module structure. Equivalent unindexed literature is a residual risk.
title: Three independent 3-torsion classes in the ternary projective cap complex
